policy.passThreshold: A portrait rated 5 is CONFIRMED SELECTED. A portrait rated 4 is PENDING EXPLICIT USER DECISION. Both satisfy the 4+ threshold for ending urgent research on that subject; 0–3 do not.
policy.gaps: Only no 4+ portrait is a subject research gap. A 3 triggers further research without re-review of that image. A 0–2 is permanently rejected forever. Narrative/group scenes do not satisfy solo-portrait coverage.
policy.stage: Separately distinguish CONFIRMED_SELECTED_5 from AWAITING_USER_REVIEW_4. Both technically count as >=4 for research-gap triage, but 4 must never be called selected or automatically approved.
policy.noRepeat: NEVER resurface human-rated 0–2 (permanent rejection), including by rephotograph/crop; NEVER resurface 3 (research-only signal). Only 4s require repeat user selection review; 5s are already selected. Show previously proposed unrated original paintings only after appropriate source/image QA. Do not destroy historical ratings.
policy.noteOnHistoricalRatings: The compact W31 matrix exposes 44 previously rated links, not the entire 277 historic rating records. If an omitted historic exact portrait rated >=4 is later found, revise status with exact original and provenance instead of duplicating review.
policy.fitField: All W36 fit fields are null; no equivalence to perfect-for-theme or suitable-elsewhere can be inferred.
policy.reviewPresentation: Show only score-4 options awaiting explicit user's decision and suitable not-yet-scored options for review; show score-5 in confirmed/selected inventory without another aesthetic review. Never display score 0–3 in the gallery, including as context, marked rejects or rerating opportunities.
policy.reviewGate: For no-4+ subject, continue finding genuinely distinct paintings; a score-4 candidate awaits user judgment; a score-5 candidate is automatically confirmed. A 4 may still need review where the subject has a 5 from another painting.

ratingSemantics.scope: All sacred-art user aesthetic ratings across previous and future review rounds

score0to2.rule: Immediately and permanently exclude from aesthetic gallery, re-review, shortlist, new candidate counts and final selections. Retain historical source/rating for audit only. New crop, resized source, file rename or photo is not a new work and cannot evade the rejection.

score3.rule: Insufficient; do not show for user re-rating or final selection. Use only internally to identify subject requiring further research, and source stronger distinct works. Preserve prior rating as evidence.

score4.rule: Present for the user's selection/confirmation review, even if another painting of the same subject has already been confirmed 5. Preserve 4 until explicitly changed; never automatically confirm, reject or suppress.

score5.rule: Automatically retain and select as aesthetically approved, no more aesthetic confirmation required. Technical identity, accurate depiction, reproducibility, licence and production checks remain separate.

nullRating.rule: Present only if a genuinely appropriate new candidate or previously proposed unscored painting and the source/image-quality gates pass; never infer approval.

ratingSemantics.categoryResearchRule: A subject/category with no qualifying subject-specific portrait scored 4 or 5 needs more paintings researched. A 4 removes the urgent research gap but is still awaiting user review; a 5 confirms a selection. Prior strong narrative scenes do not fulfill solo portrait coverage.
ratingSemantics.galleryRule: Display 4-rated works requiring the user's decision and eligible unrated new/prior proposals; 5-rated works in already-confirmed selected section. Never show 0-3 rated works as options again, not even greyed out, side-by-side or 'previously seen'.
ratingSemantics.originalIdentityRule: A rating belongs to the underlying original work. Copies, cropped photos, editions, and alternate files must not recreate rejected works as fresh candidates. Distinct physical originals only when their identifiers/provenance are established.
ratingSemantics.auditRule: Preserve all prior 0-5 data in non-UI historical ledger; do not delete or overwrite ratings to implement filter.
ratingSemantics.confirmedVsRights: 5 automatically means aesthetic selection, not automatic commercial-use rights or publication.

nextActions.focus: For 13 insufficient-score W36 subjects, research new original paintings. Never show W36 or historical 0–3 paintings for rating again. Present strong new unrated proposals plus any historic 4s only (none of these 13 has a known historic 4 solo portrait).

For 46 other no-4+ subjects, reconcile historical 277 ratings to suppress every 0–2 permanently and every 3 from future review, then source review-worthy new paintings; old 4s go to user decision and 5s to selected inventory.

Retain score-5 selections automatically, and separately bring score-4 individual artworks for user final review regardless of whether their subject has a 5; check source identity and rights after aesthetic selection.
